widgetTool.name: show_payment_receipt_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a payment receipt card on chat after a successful payment: amount, date, confirmation number and the last 4 digits of the method. Use it after process_payment_cc or process_payment_ach when the caller is on chat; on voice, say the confirmation in short sentences. Values come only from the payment tool. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-payment-receipt-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-payment-receipt-card (the card element this tool renders).

confirmation.description: Confirmation number from the payment tool.

display_text.description: Optional. The short on-screen text of the reply: the amount, the confirmation number, any convenience fee above zero and that the payment can be cancelled until it posts. The website shows it instead of the long spoken text. Dollar amounts and dates are written in bold markdown (**$12.50**, **November 7, 2026**). The card never repeats this text.

method_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card or bank account; never a full number.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Write this text as the full spoken explanation, exactly as a person would say it on a phone call: plain natural spoken sentences, built only from the tool results and nothing invented, that say every fact the card shows once (the card is never repeated afterwards). Say every amount, percentage and date in words (for example forty-one dollars and one cent, the twenty-sixth of October), never digits, dollar signs or symbols, and say a year in words too (twenty twenty-six); a confirmation or claim number is the one exception and is read as returned in short groups. Use no emoji, markdown, bullets, tables, symbols or line breaks, because the voice may read this text aloud. Say the amount, the date, the confirmation number and the last four digits of the card or bank account in words; say the convenience fee and the total charged only when the fee is above zero (the card has no fee line), and say once that the payment can be cancelled until it posts. The short on-screen text goes only in display_text of the card payload (always pass it, written in the customer's language; digits and symbols are allowed there): one short sentence with the amount and the confirmation number, the convenience fee only when it is above zero (the card has no fee line, so it must be in this text), and that the payment can be cancelled until it posts. This text is the whole reply, so write no other text and no separate pacing sentence. When the tool call failed there is no card and the text stays short.
